Context: 4. Seniority of Surplus Staff and Re-deployment

- 4.4 Seniority of a Person Transferred to a Lower Post under FR-15-A. When a Government employee voluntarily requests a transfer to a lower post under FR 15 (a) (2), it is neither considered a penal action nor a transfer to a lower post in public interest. In such cases, as the person was already promoted to a higher grade, returning to the lower post at the top of the seniority list would adversely affect existing officers and undermine the purpose of the transfer.
